info.name: libpipewire-module-echo-cancel
info.args:
{
            aec.args = {
                webrtc.noise_suppression = true
                webrtc.voice_detection = true
                webrtc.gain_control1.enabled = false
                webrtc.gain_control2.enabled = true

                # AEC3 experiments:
                webrtc.force_mono_echo_reference = true
            }
            capture.props = {
                node.name = "echo_cancel_fallback_capture"
                node.passive = true
                audio.channels = 1
                audio.position = [ MONO ]
            }
            playback.props = {
                node.name = "echo_cancel_fallback_playback"
                node.passive = true
                audio.channels = 2
                audio.position = [ FL FR ]
            }
            source.props = {
                node.name = "echo_cancel_fallback_source"
                audio.channels = 1
                audio.position = [ MONO ]
                media.class = Audio/Source
                filter.smart = true
                filter.smart.name = filter-chain-ec-fallback-source
                filter.smart.target = { media.class = Audio/Source, alsa.card_name = "SM8250 LPASS", device.profile.description = "Mic" }
                # FIXME: WirePlumber seems to invert this
                filter.smart.before = [ filter-chain-eq ]
                filter.smart.after = [ filter-chain-ns ]
                filter.smart.disabled = true
                steamos.mic_filter = true
            }
            sink.props = {
                node.name = "echo_cancel_fallback_sink"
                media.class = Audio/Sink
                audio.channels = 2
                audio.position = [ FL FR ]
                filter.smart = true
                filter.smart.name = filter-chain-ec-fallback-sink
                filter.smart.target = { media.class = Audio/Sink, alsa.card_name = "SM8250 LPASS", device.profile.description = "Speaker playback" }
                filter.smart.after = [ filter-chain-sink ]
                filter.smart.disabled = true
                steamos.mic_filter = true
            }
        }

info.name: libpipewire-module-echo-cancel
info.args:
{
            aec.args = {
                webrtc.noise_suppression = false
                webrtc.voice_detection = false
                webrtc.gain_control1.enabled = false
                webrtc.gain_control2.enabled = true

                # A longer explanation of these configuration parameters can be found at:
                # https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/pulseaudio/webrtc-audio-processing/-/blob/master/webrtc/api/audio/audio_processing.h#L229

                # Commented values are the defaults, uncomment to change.

                # GainController1:
                #webrtc.gain_control1.enable_limiter = true
                #webrtc.gain_control1.target_level_dbfs = 3
                #webrtc.gain_control1.compression_gain_db = 9

                # GainController2:
                #webrtc.gain_control2.adaptive_digital.enabled = true
                #webrtc.gain_control2.adaptive_digital.headroom_db = 5.0
                #webrtc.gain_control2.adaptive_digital.max_gain_db = 50.0
                #webrtc.gain_control2.adaptive_digital.initial_gain_db = 15.0
                #webrtc.gain_control2.adaptive_digital.max_gain_change_db_per_second = 6.0
                #webrtc.gain_control2.adaptive_digital.max_output_noise_level_dbfs = -50.0
                #webrtc.gain_control2.fixed_digital.gain_db = 0.0

                # CaptureLevelAdjustment:
                #webrtc.capture_level_adjust.enabled = false
                #webrtc.capture_level_adjust.pre_gain_factor = 1.0
                #webrtc.capture_level_adjust.post_gain_factor = 1.0

                # AEC3 experiments:
                webrtc.force_mono_echo_reference = true
                webrtc.aec3.custom = true
                webrtc.aec3.filter.refined.length_blocks = 9
                webrtc.aec3.filter.refined_initial.length_blocks = 5
                webrtc.aec3.filter.coarse.length_blocks = 9
                webrtc.aec3.filter.coarse_initial.length_blocks = 5
                webrtc.aec3.delay.num_filters = 1
                webrtc.aec3.delay.down_sampling_factor = 8
                webrtc.aec3.delay.detect_pre_echo = false
                webrtc.aec3.echo_model.model_reverb_in_nonlinear_mode = true
            }
            capture.props = {
                node.name = "echo_cancel_capture"
                node.passive = true
                audio.channels = 1
                audio.position = [ MONO ]
            }
            playback.props = {
                node.name = "echo_cancel_playback"
                node.passive = true
                audio.channels = 2
                audio.position = [ FL FR ]
            }
            source.props = {
                node.name = "echo_cancel_source"
                audio.channels = 1
                audio.position = [ MONO ]
                media.class = Audio/Source
                filter.smart = true
                filter.smart.name = filter-chain-ec-source
                filter.smart.target = { media.class = Audio/Source, alsa.card_name = "SM8250 LPASS", device.profile.description = "Mic" }
                # FIXME: WirePlumber seems to invert this
                filter.smart.before = [ filter-chain-eq ]
                filter.smart.after = [ filter-chain-ns ]
                filter.smart.disabled = true
                steamos.mic_filter = true
            }
            sink.props = {
                node.name = "echo_cancel_sink"
                media.class = Audio/Sink
                audio.channels = 2
                audio.position = [ FL FR ]
                filter.smart = true
                filter.smart.name = filter-chain-ec-sink
                filter.smart.target = { media.class = Audio/Sink, alsa.card_name = "SM8250 LPASS", device.profile.description = "Speaker playback" }
                filter.smart.after = [ filter-chain-sink ]
                filter.smart.disabled = true
                steamos.mic_filter = true
            }
        }
